lines: Target: trajectories the student itself could have produced that also pass, p_C(x) ∝ pi(x | plain prompt) * 1[x passes]
(tool responses are deterministic given the queries, so only the policy's own tokens enter the score).
-    init:  roll out with the hinted prompt until a trajectory passes (at most `init_attempts` tries)
+    init:  start from the student's own failed trajectories: cut one at a random turn and regenerate its
+           suffix with the hinted prompt, until a trajectory passes (the kept turns are then the student's
+           own exploration verbatim); if no anchored try passes, roll out with the hinted prompt instead
move:  cut x at a uniformly random turn j, keep turns < j, regenerate turns >= j with the hinted prompt -> x';
reject x' if it does not pass; otherwise keep it when the Metropolis-Hastings ratio for the
target above against this proposal is at least 1,
